_doc: What the organization decides, in one file: expected email domains and defaults. Edit it in the kit repository (merge request), then each workstation runs update. See docs/customization.md.
_defaults_doc: Organization defaults (same keys as ~/.ai-kit/overrides.json: hooks, mcp, extra_skills, disabled_commands, frictions, skill_prefix...). Each person's overrides.json is applied on top: lists add up, objects combine, the person's value wins for a single value.
